configurations.name: clash-dev
runtimeArgs: unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; cd "$HOME/Projects/Debate-Card-Cutter" && exec npm run dev -- --port 3100

configurations.name: clash-prod-local
runtimeArgs: unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; cd "$HOME/Projects/Debate-Card-Cutter" && npm run build && CLASH_LOCAL_PROD_TEST=1 exec npm run start -- --port 3200

configurations.name: clash-dev-fake
runtimeArgs: unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; cd "$HOME/Projects/Debate-Card-Cutter" && AI_FAKE=1 exec npx next dev --port 3101
